description: Seeded prose-support test set for the Jev plus Decider review. Each topic is real model-written briefing prose with the frozen title-and-summary evidence it cited, taken from runs committed to this repository. Each topic has an untouched control and three seeded edits of its prose: an appended material claim absent from the evidence (unsupported), an existing claim made more certain, broader, larger, or causal (strengthened), and an existing claim contradicted (reversed). Headlines and evidence are never edited. The edits were written by a model, not a human reviewer; a control is untouched, not verified as fully supported.
